network.auto: Refresh host data every 10 seconds while active
network.permission: Reading network interfaces requires system:network.read and a role that allows system access. An administrator can grant app permissions in the App Store.
network.metricsPermission: Traffic data requires system:metrics.read and a role that allows system access.
network.loadFailed: Could not read network data. Check the agent connection and retry.
network.unsupported: The host cannot provide this network data.
network.internetHint: This state follows the host’s configured connectivity endpoints. Its checks may be cached for 60 seconds.
network.noInterfaces: No interfaces reported by the host.
network.routesHint: This route summary lists the host’s reported default gateways. Interface addresses above include their network prefixes.
network.noGateways: No default gateways reported by the host.
network.noDns: No DNS servers reported by the host.
network.noTraffic: Per-interface traffic rates are unavailable on this host.
network.stale: Refresh failed. The previous snapshot remains visible with its retrieval time.

source.simulatedHint: These values are simulated by the development host and do not describe the real host.

diagnostic.title: Approved endpoint check
diagnostic.policy: Send a HEAD request to an HTTP endpoint approved by an administrator in the App Store. TLS is verified; every redirect target is checked against the policy.
diagnostic.permission: Endpoint checks need network:outbound. An administrator can grant it in the App Store.
diagnostic.invalid: Enter an HTTP or HTTPS URL without credentials or a fragment.
diagnostic.responseHint: An HTTP response shows that this endpoint answered. Its status describes the service response.
